title: Origin story: Achilles
description: Achilles was the son of the mortal Peleus and the sea-nymph Thetis, who dipped him in the River Styx holding him by the heel, making him invulnerable everywhere but there. Raised by the centaur Chiron, he was the Greeks' greatest warrior at Troy, where his quarrel with Agamemnon nearly lost them the war.

title: Stamina feats: Achilles
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fought for years at Troy without rest or wound; Chased Hector three times around the walls of Troy at full sprint.
